description: Modern flat in the heart of Moda, Kadıköy, with quick access to metro, ferry, and public transport. Fine dining, shops, and entertainment are within walking distance. Located on the first floor with high ceilings, offering a spacious feel. Fully equipped with high-speed internet (1000 Mbps), dishwasher, washing machine, fridge, Smart TV, vacuum, iron, coffee machine, and kitchen essentials to make you feel at home.

description:
Walking Distance to Taksim | Tranquil Home with Private Garden
Nestled just minutes from Taksim Square, this modern apartment offers two bedrooms, a spacious living room, and AC in every room. Step into your private garden 🌿 — swing gently, sip coffee under the gazebo, or enjoy a cozy BBQ. Whether you’re exploring Istanbul’s energy or seeking a peaceful retreat, this home is your perfect escape. 💛

[{"id": "1595538231827387790", "text": "Ms. Ayse’s apartment is one of the easiest to reach from Taksim Square, just a 3–4 minute walk, which is rare in Cihangir/Gümüşsuyu given the hills. The building has a lift, making moving luggage effortless, and while the exterior is in decent condition, the flat itself is flawless. Inside, it feels warm and cozy yet spacious, tastefully decorated, exceptionally clean, and thoughtfully lit. Natural signs of wear add charm and character rather than detract. Bedrooms, bathroom, kitchen, and entertainment options all exceeded expectations, making the stay comfortable and memorable. The private patio garden is a highlight, offering complete privacy and a peaceful outdoor space. The location is excellent, with a convenience store nearby and plenty of cafés and restaurants within walking distance. description:
Hello, I’m Sadik. I have been hosting you since 2019 to provide you with a perfect Istanbul experience. This flat is right in the heart of Cihangir (innovative district of Istanbul), which has a very central location.
Here is the list of things you can do by walking
10 minutes from the apartment :)
You can be in Galata Port, Taksim Square, Istiklal Street, take a tram to Hagia Sophia or Topkapi Palace, enjoy the Bosphorus with Turkish coffee, hang out in innovative bars.
reviews_json:
[{"id": "925878223966892969", "text": "My reviews for Sadik house is excellent. The house is as described in the pictures. Neat clean. Towels and extra bedsheet available. Kitchen and AC is perfect. Sadik was a great helpful host. His house was perfect and our stay was very comfortable.
Issues with building and location:
1) It has a small lift and it was hard to fit our graco baby stroller inside out. We have to take two turns to enter and exit the lift
2) there few stairs entering the building and than again few more stairs to go the lift so family people with baby strollers or wheelchair will be difficult
Lastly the apartment is on a steep hill and again with baby strollers it difficult to go to Takism or the tram. Climbing up and down is very steep and dangerous with cars moving around. We had to do taxi everyday to go out and come back home.
Lastly the apartment was excellent for people without kids."}, {"id": "1726766191502984948", "text": "My wife and I stayed here for about a month. The location is in the heart of Cihangir with very good access to public transportation. Like most of the neighborhood, it’s very hilly. Walking to Taksim is mostly uphill with a lot of stairs, while walking down to Kabataş is easier. That’s just part of staying in Cihangir and makes it convenient to access the ferries, trams, and buses.
Sadik was very responsive and quick to help whenever we needed anything.
The apartment is smaller than it appears in the photos. The furniture and bed are dated and could be updated. The shower had some mold that should be cleaned. It’s suitable for one or two people.
The internet connection was reliable. There is a small table for working, but the limited space makes it less practical if you’re working remotely. There is one air conditioner in the main living area.
Overall, I would recommend it and will be back for a short stay because of the location and the responsive host."}, {"id": "1694186052711341159", "text": "I had a wonderful stay at Sadık's place and would definitely stay there again! The apartment matches the description and is even better than the pictures. It feels like being at home, you'll find everything you need for a comfortable stay. If planning a long-term stay, you'll have nothing to worry. There's a washing/drying machine, and a well-equipped kitchen to cook your own meals if you prefer. There are grocery shops and markets nearby to stock up. If you don't want to cook, there are affordable restaurants in the neighborhood too... all within walking distance. The location is great, a safe neighborhood that's well connected to tourist areas but remains quiet and peaceful compared to busier tourist spots. Tram and bus stops are close and easy to reach. I ejoyed my stay very much and I appreciated the details like extra chargers, cooking ingredients and bathroom items readily available. Special thanks to Sadık for being such a great host: friendly, responsive and helpful!"}, {"id": "847674652463021513", "text": "It has been a pleasure to stay at Sadik’s flat in Istanbul! The flat is located perfectly, at a quiet street very close to all public transport stops and the seaside and 2 mins away from a lively neighborhood with coffee shops, bars and nice local places. The flat is small, but was enough for us as a couple. The bed is comfortable, the kitchen has everything for cooking, shower is clean.
Sadik is a great host, he helped us to check in and was always available for our questions."}, {"id": "1461467942403934278", "text": "I had a wonderful stay in this beautifully decorated apartment in the heart of Cihangir, Beyoğlu. The location is absolutely perfect—close to everything, yet peaceful and charming. The apartment was exactly as described, clean, stylish, and very comfortable.
What truly made the experience special was the host—warm, welcoming, and always ready to help with anything I needed. You can really feel that they care about their guests.
I would absolutely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul and would love to stay here again in the future!"}]

description: This is the house at the centre of Cihangir which is considered the home for artist, international people. You can easily find any kind of food, bakery, art galleries, transportations within 10 min walk. Taksim(İstiklal) is 5 min away too. And the town is quite safe so you can walk 24/7. We are 2 min away from you in case of any need. The building has a lift, and it is quite brand new so the furniture are brand new too. We do run airbnb in the building so you will have fun to stay here

[{"id": "1271624486276289522", "text": "Positive: The apartment and neighborhood are nice, with a supermarket, bakery, and small shops just 3-4 minutes away. Istiklal Rd and Taksim Square are 10-15 minutes away, and the train is 10 minutes away. The water and coffee was waiting for us in the apartment.
Negative: Avoid booking a taxi through the host. He promised a VIP Mercedes or VW to pick us up at the airport, but we regretted it. The car was dirty, no phone chargers, smelled of cigarettes, and the driver smoked during the ride. No water was provided. I had requested photos of the car beforehand, which I never received. Book your taxi through Tripadvisor instead!! The only downside to the apartment was mold in the bathroom and the smell from it, which I hope they address soon.

The hosts are genuinely nice people and very accommodating.

All the walls have a rough plaster finish instead of paint or wallpaper. The pink color seen in the photos is the rough plaster finish, which gives the flat an unfinished look.

description:
- Pesa Suites offers its guests a comfortable accommodation experience with its stylish and modern design.
- Located in the center of Istanbul, Pesa Suites is within walking distance of the city's historical and entertainment venues.
- There is daily cleaning and 24-hour reception service.

This is a studio flat containing one bedroom and living room monolithically.
It's industrial design, mostly woodwork furniture , floor, functional space usage makes the flat joyful.
You can enjoy the original sauna .
The elevator is a unique feature.
The ceiling high windows capture the daylight in the most perfect way.

[{"id": "1314381859022915984", "text": "Özra's apartment is so spacious, good water pressure, always hot water, filterd drinking water and privet sauna in the apartment. Bed was comfortable, clean and plenty of extra linens. Washer in apartment. The kitchen has plenty of utensils to cook. There are many windows that can be opened and let air and sun light come in. I stayed during winter and the heat system kept the apartment very comfortable. There is a small elevator that opens into the apartment. Great location near public transportation, local shops, restaurants and grocery stores. Things to consider: Due to the location the weekend nights can be noisy, I am a light sleeper and I was able to sleep well. Wood floors can be squeaky, but the apartment is on the top floor so there is no one above you. Overall it is a great stay and Özra is very friendly and helpful."}, {"id": "1425983787666113732", "text": "Thank you Ozra for the lovely stay! The studio matches the photos pretty accurately, in addition there are more curtains to separate the studio, which is always nice.
The location is very convenient to anyone who wants to explore the sights, everything is pretty much in walkable distance and I am sure you will love to stay here!
However, the sauna wasn't hot enough to keep us warm in the rainy cold weather, but still was very much appreciated.
Note that the neighbourhood is kinda noisy in the evenings and nights till around 2-3 am, especially during the weekend. So if you are a sensitive sleeper, we would recommend bringing a pair of earplugs with you :)
The hot water wasn't an issue (we had a poor experience before), although it wasn't easy to set up the right temperature.
Overall, a good place to stay in Istanbul, Ozra is definitely an excellent host, but maybe worth if you stay for shorter period of time or with a group of 3 or 4 people to cover expenses."}, {"id": "1164306227929507884", "text": "For the most part this is a great AirBnB. The apartment is well stocked and clean. Unfortunately there are some downsides which prevent me from giving 5 stars. There is one AC unit at the far end of the studio which is very ineffective. description: Welcome to Terrace Sanctuary—a refined 2-bedroom apartment in Şişli where modern design meets everyday comfort. Spread across two levels in a standalone building, this stylish home is perfect for families, couples, or business travelers seeking a peaceful yet central Istanbul stay.

[{"id": "1770868952500208732", "text": "I wanted to share my experience after staying here for one week in Istanbul. The hosts were lovely, kind, and very helpful, with clear instructions. description:
Our 3 Bedroom large and design apartment is on the 3rd floor with high enterance of a historical building.
50 meters to Galata Tower.
3 Bdr. has 3 shower, 3 A/C and there are 2 WC in the apartment.
Cosy and boutique cafes and restaurants, independent design shops, galleries and wine cellars are all within walking distance. By walking 4-5 minutes to Karaköy you can take tram and go to Hagia Sofia, Topkapı Palace, Sultan Ahmet Mosque and Grand Bazaar Area...
Our wi-fi is limitless with 50 mbps.

[{"id": "716385262555192157", "text": "Erdem is absolutely the best host we have come across. He is always available, always responsive, and always helpful.

His tour suggestions were very good and we saw everything we wanted and more. As a finally to our perfect stay Erdem arrange dinner for us at Tershane Restaurant. Outstanding!
Erdems flat is exactly as advertised. It is comfortable, centrally located, and clean. I block from Galata Tower and an easy walk to all the main sights, metro, busses, and ferries.
The flat is up a few flights of stairs, so if you have heavy luggage or have accessibility limitations this might not fit. Also there is a mosque next door, so calls to prayer may bother some. We thought the hike up stairs were worth the view while sipping wine from the balcony. The mosque adds a cultural twist.
Erdem has done a wonderful job in establishing a high bar for Airbnb hosts. description: This apartment in the center of Kadıköy is ideally located for your trip. Our only flaw is that we do not have an elevator even though our building is new. The apartment is on the top floor (5th) but believe me, the view is worth it :)

description: Located at the seaside of Cihangir/Beyoglu (hip area in Istanbul full of cafes, bars and galleries) this 160 m2 deluxe flat is 2 minutes walk to seaside & tramway, 15 minutes walk to Taksim city centre & subway. Designed with japandi style furnitures, this bright apartment has magnificient bosphorus view on all its rooms and areas. It accommodates up to 6 people. From espresso machine to cold water dispenser, yoga equipments or free netflix... All your needs for a dreamy holiday are available.
